nodes.label: Postgres memory tuning for 8GB VPS
nodes.rationale: Old values (shared_buffers=1GB, max_connections=150, work_mem=32MB) were sized for a 16GB blueprint; on 8GB Postgres became the largest process and the one the kernel OOM-killer picked when a nixpacks build requested 2GB, taking the DB offline for every tenant. New values keep total memory under 1.5GB instead of up to 3GB, freeing roughly 1GB — about two more tenants of headroom.

nodes.label: PgBouncer AUTH_QUERY against pgbouncer_auth
nodes.rationale: The pgbouncer image only generates userlist.txt from DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD (just 'postgres'), so per-tenant authenticator_<slug> roles aren't in it. AUTH_QUERY authenticates them directly against pg_shadow instead of silently mapping them to postgres, which would make PostgREST superuser in every tenant DB and bypass RLS everywhere. AUTH_DBNAME=postgres is required because the auth function only exists in the 'postgres' database — without it every tenant DB's AUTH_QUERY fails and GoTrue/PostgREST can never connect.
